From Space Trucking · Price: you need your deck, and it can be taken.

Theme Space

  • 1: 1 action: store an object of Bulk 1 or less between two cards, or pull one out.
  • 5: Store a Small or smaller creature (willing, or @Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates) for up to 1 minute.
  • 9: Surge: throw a card at a creature; a stored object bursts out for @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 13: Store a Medium creature (it counts as sealed, see Defaults).
  • 17: Store creatures up to Large.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
